front.title: A Post-Quantum Cryptographic Profile for DNP3 Secure Authentication Version 5

abstract.t:
This document specifies a post-quantum cryptographic profile for DNP3 Secure Authentication version 5 (SAv5). It defines an ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA authentication exchange, HKDF-SHA-256 session keys, canonical DNP3 application protocol data unit (APDU) encoding, transport segmentation, and HMAC-SHA-256 protection of application messages.
This Internet-Draft is a proposal for Standards Track publication. The APDU uses DNP3 application control, authentication function codes, response internal indications, and a length-delimited post- quantum authentication object. The object variation and any externally allocated algorithm identifiers require coordination with the responsible DNP3 standards authority. A local experimental selector is specified only for explicitly configured laboratory use; this document does not assign an IEEE or IEC identifier.
